svg.aria-label: Anatomy of an OpenShell sandbox: the gateway holds policies and credentials; a sandbox is a workload pod (agent as user sandbox, Landlock, seccomp, no direct network, placeholder secrets) plus a supervisor pod (deny-by-default L4/L7 policy, credential injection, FQDN-only DNS, OCSF audit, live policy updates). LiteLLM is allowed, api.github.com is allowed for GET after a policy update, the rest of the internet is denied. Kubernetes adds admission labels and a Kyverno guardrail.
svg.title: What a sandbox is

svg.text: Security layers around one agent: an OpenShell sandbox is a workload pod plus a supervisor pod

g.text: e.g. pi · runs as user sandbox

svg.text: denied in v1, allowed in v2, no restart

g.text: no host network · no host PID · no host IPC
